QuestInfo.name: Clothes Make the Man
QuestInfo.0: You could see why Tina would be upset with Blake. Go talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Tina wants you to find outfits for the autograph event. The theme for the outfit is cute & cuddly. She wants you to bring back a Bunny Suit from Kid Mannequin.
QuestInfo.2: Blake pitched a fit when he saw the Bunny Suit. He said he would wear it before, so why is he being so difficult now?

0.0: How did Blake respond? ...Didn't like any of them, huh? Unbelievable. He's originally from Kerning City, y'know.
0.1: He really is a different person. I wouldn't deal with him if it wasn't my job... I seriously can't stand him anymore!
0.2: Blake said that he wanted the concept of this autograph event to be cute & cuddly. I don't know if that'll mesh with his new song but whatever. We'll do it his way, or he'll flip out, I'm sure.

yes.0: I think Kid Mannequin's Bunny Suit would be perfect. Go to the 5th and 6th floor and get #b50 Bunny Outfits#k for Blake. I'm sure he'll want one that's just perfect.

no.0: Ah, you're busy? I hope Blake doesn't throw a tantrum...

1.0: ...Yes? What, you brought outfits for the event? Let me see.

yes.0: ...What the heck is THIS?! You can't expect me to wear this RIDICULOUS get-up. Why would you bring me something like this?
yes.1: So, this was Tina's idea? She really is the worst stylist. I'll give her one more chance, but if she pulls something like this again...

npc.0: I think a Kid Mannequin's Bunny Suit would be perfect. Go to the 5th and 6th floor and get 50 Bunny Outfits for Blake.

item.0: What do you want? Are you on my staff? I'm not talking to fans at this time.
